# Panels markup reference

StackPanel, Grid, DockPanel, WrapPanel, UniformGrid, SplitPanel, and Canvas.

### Panel

Receiver: `Panel` and derived types (`where T : Panel`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Children(params Element[] children)` | `Add`, `AddRange` | Adds children to the panel. |
| `ClipToBounds(bool value = true)` | `ClipToBounds` | Sets whether children are clipped to the panel bounds. |
| `Padding(Thickness value)` | `Padding` | Sets the inner padding between the panel bounds and its children. |
| `Padding(double horizontal, double vertical)` |  | Sets horizontal and vertical padding. |
| `Padding(double left, double top, double right, double bottom)` |  | Sets padding for each side individually. |
| `Padding(double uniform)` | `Padding` | Sets uniform padding on all sides. |

### DockPanel

Receiver: `DockPanel`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `LastChildFill(bool value = true)` | `LastChildFill` | Sets whether the last child fills the remaining space instead of docking; the default is true. |
| `Spacing(double value)` | `Spacing` | Sets the spacing between children in DIPs. |

### Grid

Receiver: `Grid` and derived types (`where T : Grid`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AutoIndexing(bool value = true)` | `AutoIndexing` | Sets whether children without an explicit row and column are placed in the first free cell; the default is true. |
| `Columns(params GridLength[] columns)` |  | Defines columns for the grid. |
| `Columns(string definition)` |  | Defines columns using string syntax: "Auto,*,2*,100" |
| `Rows(params GridLength[] rows)` |  | Defines rows for the grid. |
| `Rows(string definition)` |  | Defines rows using string syntax: "Auto,*,2*,100" |
| `ShareStarSize(bool value = true)` | `ShareStarSize` | Sets whether all star rows and all star columns take the measure size of the largest star track on their axis, scaled by weight. |
| `ShowGridLine(bool value = true)` | `ShowGridLine` | Sets whether lines are drawn between rows and columns, for layout debugging. |
| `Spacing(double value)` | `Spacing` | Sets the spacing between rows and between columns in DIPs. |

### SplitPanel

Receiver: `SplitPanel`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `First(UIElement value)` | `First` | Sets the element shown in the first pane, or null for an empty pane. |
| `FirstLength(GridLength value)` | `FirstLength` | Sets the first pane length; a star value (the default) shares the remaining space with a star-sized second pane by weight. |
| `Horizontal()` | `Orientation = Horizontal` | Sets horizontal orientation. |
| `MaxFirst(double value)` | `MaxFirst` | Sets the maximum length of the first pane in DIPs; the default is no bound. |
| `MaxSecond(double value)` | `MaxSecond` | Sets the maximum length of the second pane in DIPs; the default is no bound. |
| `MinFirst(double value)` | `MinFirst` | Sets the minimum length of the first pane in DIPs. |
| `MinSecond(double value)` | `MinSecond` | Sets the minimum length of the second pane in DIPs. |
| `Orientation(Orientation value)` | `Orientation` | Sets the split direction; Horizontal (the default) places the panes left and right, Vertical top and bottom. |
| `Second(UIElement value)` | `Second` | Sets the element shown in the second pane, or null for an empty pane. |
| `SecondLength(GridLength value)` | `SecondLength` | Sets the second pane length; a star value (the default) shares the remaining space with a star-sized first pane by weight. |
| `SplitterThickness(double value)` | `SplitterThickness` | Sets the splitter thickness in DIPs; the default is 8. |
| `Vertical()` | `Orientation = Vertical` | Sets vertical orientation. |

### StackPanel

Receiver: `StackPanel` and derived types (`where T : StackPanel`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Horizontal()` | `Orientation = Horizontal` | Sets horizontal orientation. |
| `Orientation(Orientation value)` | `Orientation` | Sets the axis along which children are stacked; the default is Vertical. |
| `Spacing(double value)` | `Spacing` | Sets the spacing between children in DIPs. |
| `Vertical()` | `Orientation = Vertical` | Sets vertical orientation. |

### UniformGrid

Receiver: `UniformGrid` and derived types (`where T : UniformGrid`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Columns(int value)` | `Columns` | Sets the number of columns; 0 (the default) derives it from the child count. |
| `Rows(int value)` | `Rows` | Sets the number of rows; 0 (the default) derives it from the child count. |
| `Spacing(double value)` | `Spacing` | Sets the spacing between cells in DIPs, for both row and column gaps. |

### WrapPanel

Receiver: `WrapPanel` and derived types (`where T : WrapPanel`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Horizontal()` | `Orientation = Horizontal` | Sets horizontal orientation. |
| `ItemHeight(double value)` | `ItemHeight` | Sets a fixed height for all items in DIPs; NaN (the default) sizes each item to its content. |
| `ItemWidth(double value)` | `ItemWidth` | Sets a fixed width for all items in DIPs; NaN (the default) sizes each item to its content. |
| `Orientation(Orientation value)` | `Orientation` | Sets the axis along which items flow before wrapping; the default is Horizontal. |
| `Spacing(double value)` | `Spacing` | Sets the spacing between items and between lines in DIPs. |
| `Vertical()` | `Orientation = Vertical` | Sets vertical orientation. |
